title: GauxPro Christmas Kids Show
seo_title: GauxPro Christmas Kids Show in Joplin, MO – Dec 5, 2026
description: The GauxPro Christmas Kids Show is a holiday-themed kids show hosted by GauxPro Performance Horses. Buckles for all arounds have been ordered, a new show bill and patterns are coming soon, and sponsorship forms are available. It runs Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM at 5585 W Belle Center Road in Joplin, MO.
